name: Test the reach of a word like “every”

uses.action: Listen to a claim about every tested tooth. Hold the jig setting fixed across two marked spares, then challenge the word “every” with the spare that held.
Use two dated tokens against the claim that an equal queue place always gives both buyers access.

name: Find what changes when a comparison uses a different base

uses.action: Pay the same coin from four and ten, compare the original purse with its remainder and challenge the claim of equal proportional cost.

name: Separate what the evidence establishes from what the town decides

uses.action: Fit the family stub, date the sister’s arrival and challenge a rule that treats a family name as eyewitness evidence. The policy for who can enter stays open.

name: Check a claim about a group against the way cases were selected

uses.action: Follow two stamped ends past a common pin. Challenge the inference that a selected tray represents one delivery.

name: Repair an opening phrase whose subject has gone missing

uses.action: Set two different grammatical subjects beneath the opening phrase. Compare who now counts with the tally and challenge the assumption that only the collector changed.
